reason: Most of my collabs are free meals and products, so there's no rate to negotiate and nothing for payment reminders to chase. My WhatsApp groups already tell me which brands are dodgy, and I'm not linking my Instagram to some beta app from a small team just for that.
objection: Giving an app access to my Instagram, and letting it send messages to brands from my account, feels risky. If it says something weird or my account gets flagged, that's my reputation with local brands gone.
would_change_my_mind: A creator from one of my WhatsApp groups using it and saying it got them paid instead of just bartered, plus a way to use the scam check and rate advice without connecting my Instagram at all.
